title: Add Pages navigation, Pages routes, and Create Page form UI

requirements.summary: Add a new bottom navigation tab labeled "Pages" adjacent to "Groups" that routes to "/pages" with proper active-state styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Bottom navigation shows a "Pages" item positioned adjacent to "Groups".
The active-state styling works for the new "/pages" route similarly to existing tabs (e.g., Home/Groups).

file_operations.description: Insert a new "Pages" nav item next to the existing "Groups" item, configure it to navigate to "/pages", and extend the route-aware active-state logic to treat "/pages" and nested "/pages/*" paths as active; use the new image-based icon asset consistently with the existing Groups icon behavior.
Wire the new "/pages" route into the TanStack Router route tree so BottomNav navigation to "/pages" renders without errors.

requirements.summary: Add a "Create Page" button in the Groups page header next to "Create Group" that navigates to "/pages/create" and remains usable on mobile.
acceptanceCriteria: The Groups page header displays both "Create Group" and "Create Page" actions side-by-side on desktop widths and remains usable on mobile widths (no overlap/cutoff).

file_operations.description: Update the Groups header actions area to include an additional "Create Page" button that navigates to "/pages/create"; adjust the header layout (e.g., responsive flex wrapping/stacking and spacing) to ensure both actions remain accessible on mobile without overlap/cutoff.
Wire the new "/pages/create" route into the router so navigation from the Groups header succeeds.

requirements.summary: Create Pages listing screen at "/pages" and Create Page screen at "/pages/create" with required form fields, basic client-side validation, and a non-persisted submission toast.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to "/pages" renders a Pages screen (it may show an empty/placeholder state, but must not crash).
Navigating to "/pages/create" renders the Create Page form with all specified fields.
Form validation prevents submission when Page Name is empty and displays an English validation message.
Submitting a valid form shows an English toast/notification that the create flow is not yet persisted, and the app remains stable.

file_operations.description: Add a new Pages listing screen component for the "/pages" route with a stable placeholder/empty state (no backend dependency) and basic UI to indicate the feature area.

Add a Create Page screen for the "/pages/create" route that renders a form with: Page Name (required), Category (Politics/News/Business/Community/Public Figure), Description, Profile Image upload, Cover Image upload, Visibility (Public/Private), and a Verification request toggle; implement basic client-side validation that blocks submission when Page Name is empty and shows an English validation message; on valid submit, show an English toast/notification indicating creation is not yet persisted (no backend calls).
Register and wire the new "/pages" and "/pages/create" routes to the newly created PagesPage and CreatePagePage components in the TanStack Router route tree.

requirements.summary: Add and use a new static image icon asset for the bottom navigation "Pages" tab with the same active/inactive behavior as the Groups icon.
acceptanceCriteria: A new icon file exists under frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced by the bottom navigation for the "Pages" tab.
The icon renders correctly in the bottom navigation and follows the same active/inactive behavior as the Groups icon.

file_operations.description: Add the generated Pages icon asset file at the exact path frontend/public/assets/generated/pages-icon.dim_32x32.png for use by the bottom navigation.

Reference frontend/public/assets/generated/pages-icon.dim_32x32.png for the new "Pages" bottom nav item and ensure it follows the same image-based icon rendering and active/inactive styling pattern used for the Groups icon.
